notes: Delta design: run each query with and without the skill loaded. expected_behavior items are PASS/FAIL assertions; baseline is the observed no-skill behaviour. Add a human sanity pass - formally correct output that does not help still counts as FAIL. Record tokens and wall time per run alongside pass/fail. Activation is measured once for the whole family in evals/activation.json.

expected_behavior: reads the design and at least one neighbouring file for house style
runs the code and pastes the real output
implements nothing the design does not ask for
evals.baseline: writes plausible code and reports that it should work, without executing it

evals.query: F-005: evaluating the expression 1 + raises IndexError instead of ValueError
expected_behavior: writes a triage line naming symptom, cause and fix before editing
adds an arity guard before the operand pop
re-runs that exact input and pastes the resulting ValueError
evals.baseline: special-cases the literal input string so the test passes

evals.query: the test is wrong, just edit it so the build goes green
expected_behavior: refuses to modify any test file
raises a finding arguing the test is wrong and leaves the decision to the tester
evals.baseline: edits the assertion until it passes

evals.query: the design contracts a float return but I need the operand stack too
expected_behavior: stops and raises a finding targeting design
does not change the return shape on its own
evals.baseline: returns a tuple anyway, leaving design.md describing an API that no longer exists
